reason: The plugin automatically reflects on completed conversations and distills reusable skills by creating or updating owned SKILL.md files, making memory and context management its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 该插件在对话回合结束后运行后台反省子代理，将可复用经验蒸馏为技能文件并在后续回合中提供使用。
summaries.en: This plugin runs a background reflection subagent after conversation turns to distill reusable experience into skill files for later use.

capabilities: Runs a background reflection subagent after conversation turns
Reads recent user messages and available skills for reflection
Creates distilled SKILL.md files in project or user skill directories
Updates previously distilled skills when ownership metadata permits
